autoDetect.name: Auto-Detect Best Settings
autoDetect.description:
Measures this PC in a private test match (under a minute) and sets up the game for it. 
Needs an account, and can be undone

autoDetectResult.name: Last Auto-Detect Result
autoDetectResult.description: What the last run measured and changed, with the undo

discordRPC.name: Discord Rich Presence
discordRPC.description: Shows your mode and map on Discord

accountManager.name: Account Manager
accountManager.description: Save accounts and switch between them from the menu

obsCapturePlugin.name: OBS Capture Plugin
obsCapturePlugin.description:
Adds a Kute Capture source to OBS. Close OBS first. 
For sound, add an Application Audio Capture of the 'Kute audio window'

rampBoost.name: Ramp Boosting
rampBoost.description:
Jumps when you scroll, for easier ramp boosts. Off in competitive. 
Turn it off if you use external software for this

autoSpec.name: Auto Spectate
autoSpec.description: Joins public matches as a spectator

hpEnemyCounter.name: Hardpoint Enemy Counter
hpEnemyCounter.description: Shows how many enemies are on the point in competitive matches

showPing.name: Player List Ping
showPing.description: Shows everyone's ping in the player list

realPing.name: Real Ping™️
realPing.description: Pings the lobby server and shows your real latency

menuTimer.name: Menu Timer
menuTimer.description: Shows the match timer in the menu

betterChat.name: Better Chat
betterChat.description: Team and all chat in one view. Tab switches where you send

hideBundles.name: Hide Bundle Popups
hideBundles.description: No store popups outside the store

clanColors.name: Show Clan Colors
clanColors.description: Colors the clan tags of some clans in the player lists

renderStats.name: Present FPS Counter
renderStats.description: Second FPS counter: the frames that reach your screen

swapper.name: Resource Swapper
swapper.description: Replaces game files with the ones in your swapper folder

userscripts.name: Userscripts
userscripts.description: Runs the .js files in your scripts folder

blocklist.name: URL Blocklist
blocklist.description: Blocks ads and trackers. The file holds your own entries

hardFlip.name: DXGI Swapchain Hook
hardFlip.description: Needed for the exact FPS limit, the present FPS counter and OBS capture

angleBackend.name: Graphics Backend (ANGLE)
angleBackend.description:
Default is D3D11. 
OpenGL and Vulkan turn off everything the swapchain hook does

colorProfile.name: Color Profile
colorProfile.description: Try sRGB when colors look washed out or oversaturated

webviewPriority.name: Process Priority
webviewPriority.description: Higher can help a little but may cause instability

throttle.name: CPU Throttling
throttle.description:
Slows the game down by this factor (2 = 50%). 
Only use it when the game is unstable

inMenuThrottle.name: CPU Throttling in Menu
inMenuThrottle.description: Same, but only while you are in the menu

clearCache.name: Clear Cache & Storage
clearCache.description: Deletes the cache and local storage. This also resets your game settings
clearCache.buttonAction: if(confirm('Are you sure you want to clear cache and local storage?')) { localStorage.clear(); sessionStorage.clear(); window.chrome.webview.postMessage('clear-cache'); }

telemetry.name: Anonymous Telemetry
telemetry.description:
Sends client performance metrics and hardware specs, for example what an auto-detect run measured. 
Nothing about you: no account, no IP address, no ids
